_comment: Voice ids and delivery settings per language and kind, read by scripts/build-audio.js. A kind may name its own voiceId and model; otherwise it uses the language's. Changing anything here changes every item's hash it applies to, so the next build re-renders what it touches. No secrets live here; the API key comes from ELEVENLABS_API_KEY. Traditional prayers use the voice REMAM's prayer audio uses (dougdevitre/remam, scripts/generate-prayer-audio.mjs), in both languages, so the two apps' prayers sound the same; they start from the prayer settings and take stability, style and speed from their own entry in prayers.js when it has them.

prayer.voiceName: REMAM prayer voice (same recordings as remam-regional/audio/prayers)
